newsitem.title: USA: Woolworth to close Phoenix distribution center.
newsitem.headline: Woolworth to close Phoenix distribution center.

text.p: Woolworth Corp said Monday it plans to close its distribution center in Phoenix by May 1, 1997.
The 293,000 square foot Phoenix facility employs 250 people.
"All 250 people will be laid off," company spokeswoman Frances Trachter told Reuters.
She declined to disclose the amount the company plans to save through closing the center.
The company said the action is part of its strategy of streamlining its distribution process through consolidation.
The Phoenix facility handles merchandise for the company's Lady Foot Locker, Kids Foot Locker and Colorado outdoor apparel and footware stores.
When the center closes, the company said this work will be taken over by the company's center in Junction City, Kan.
